name: Overdraft / NSF Fee Recompute Check
outcome: Recompute overdraft and NSF fee events in two stages: an independent replay of the posted ledger under the caller's declared posting-order policy and fee schedule, diffed by post date and fee type against caller-supplied core-charged fees with a MATCHES, DIVERGES, or INDETERMINATE verdict (ART-662), then a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). Posting order and every fee-schedule term are caller-declared inputs; a divergence is an arithmetic finding, never a determination that a fee was charged incorrectly. Not legal advice.
